scientific_integrity: The rational homology concentration is proved from exact finite boundary ranks; the full character follows by signed simplicial trace enumeration and standard finite-group representation theory. The underlying wedge-of-23-spheres homotopy classification is explicitly credited as previous work.
scientific_limitations: One finite icosahedral graph; no integral group-ring decomposition or integral torsion claim, no equivariant homotopy equivalence, and no absolute bibliographic priority claim.
title: Rational \(A_5\times C_2\)-characters of the icosahedral neighborhood complex
